dogecoin.text: What is crazy is that #Robinhood doesn’t let you own any crypto. For instance, when you buy #dogecoin on Robinhood, you can’t move it to another trading platform or even your own wallet. #RobinhoodIPO

According to #Robinhood's pre-IPO almost 20% of the app’s revenue this year was from selling #cryptocurrency. Of that 20%, a third was from #dogecoin specifically. But this is not the crazy part. #RobinhoodIPO
